howl.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
howl.flavor: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

scary_face.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
scary_face.flavor: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

snarl.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
snarl.flavor: The user yells as if it’s ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

twineedle.effect: Hits twice in the same turn.  Has a chance to poison the target.
twineedle.flavor: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. This may also poison the target.

poison_jab.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
poison_jab.flavor: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

thunder_shock.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder_shock.flavor: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunderbolt.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunderbolt.flavor: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

sunny_day.effect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
sunny_day.flavor: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

rain_dance.effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.
rain_dance.flavor: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

sandstorm.effect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.
sandstorm.flavor: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.

sweet_kiss.flavor: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

supersonic.flavor: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

defense_curl.effect: Raises user’s Defense by one stage.
defense_curl.flavor: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.

headbutt.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
headbutt.flavor: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.

hyper_fang.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
hyper_fang.flavor: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

charm.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
charm.flavor: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target’s Attack stat.

spark.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
spark.flavor: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

nuzzle.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
nuzzle.flavor: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

swift.flavor: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

thunder_wave.flavor: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

discharge.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
discharge.flavor: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

agility.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
agility.flavor: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

air_slash.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
air_slash.flavor: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

tackle.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
tackle.flavor: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

scratch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
scratch.flavor: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

pound.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
pound.flavor: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

quick_attack.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
quick_attack.flavor: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

growl.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
growl.flavor: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

leer.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
leer.flavor: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.

harden.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.
harden.flavor: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.

sand_attack.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.
sand_attack.flavor: Sand is hurled in the target’s face, lowering the target’s accuracy.

ember.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
ember.flavor: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

peck.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
peck.flavor: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.

double_kick.flavor: The user attacks by kicking the target twice in a row using two feet.

vine_whip.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
vine_whip.flavor: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

razor_leaf.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
razor_leaf.flavor: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

poison_powder.flavor: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

sleep_powder.flavor: The user scatters a cloud of soporific dust that puts the target to sleep.

bubble.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
bubble.flavor: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their Speed stat.

water_gun.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
water_gun.flavor: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

water_pulse.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
water_pulse.flavor: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

string_shot.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
string_shot.flavor: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.

poison_sting.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
poison_sting.flavor: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

bug_bite.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
bug_bite.flavor: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

wing_attack.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
wing_attack.flavor: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

bite.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
bite.flavor: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

dragon_rage.flavor: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

dragon_breath.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
dragon_breath.flavor: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

confusion.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
confusion.flavor: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.

psybeam.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
psybeam.flavor: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

shadow_claw.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
shadow_claw.flavor: The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

flame_wheel.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.  Lets frozen Pokémon thaw themselves.
flame_wheel.flavor: The user attacks by cloaking itself in fire and charging at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

take_down.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
take_down.flavor: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

slash.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
slash.flavor: The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

seed_bomb.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
seed_bomb.flavor: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

giga_drain.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
giga_drain.flavor: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

earthquake.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.
earthquake.flavor: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

flamethrower.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
flamethrower.flavor: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

blaze_kick.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to burn the target.
blaze_kick.flavor: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with a burn.

sky_uppercut.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Bounce and Fly users.
sky_uppercut.flavor: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

close_combat.effect: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
close_combat.flavor: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

surf.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.
surf.flavor: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

night_slash.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
night_slash.flavor: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

dark_pulse.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
dark_pulse.flavor: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

crunch.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
crunch.flavor: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

aerial_ace.flavor: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

gust.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Pokémon in the air.
gust.flavor: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

bug_buzz.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
bug_buzz.flavor: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

dragon_claw.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
dragon_claw.flavor: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

heat_wave.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
heat_wave.flavor: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.

flare_blitz.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.  Has a chance to burn the target.
flare_blitz.flavor: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.

water_shuriken.flavor: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.

cut.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
cut.flavor: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

fly.effect: User flies high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
fly.flavor: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

strength.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
strength.flavor: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

flash.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.
flash.flavor: The user flashes a light that lowers the target’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

rock_smash.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
rock_smash.flavor: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

waterfall.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.flavor: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

dive.effect: User dives underwater, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
dive.flavor: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.
